title: Thread Database Migrations Historical Checksum Manifest
description: Authoritative immutable record of applied database migrations and their SHA-256 checksums.

001_initial_schema.description: Initial schema: source_records, memory_chunks, guild_installations, processed_interactions, import_approvals

002_provenance_and_schema_hardening.description: Provenance & schema hardening: source_uri, source_timestamp, quarantine unverifiable chunks, generated fts, initial embedding_v2 swap

003_zero_direct_access_rls.description: Zero direct access RLS: Force RLS on all tables, restrict direct SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE to service_role

004_hybrid_search_rpc.description: Hybrid search RPC: Pre-retrieval SQL ACL enforcement, dense pgvector cosine similarity + sparse PostgreSQL FTS with RRF

005_transactional_rpcs.description: Transactional persistence & promotion: persist_record_and_chunks and promote_quarantined_chunks atomic RPCs

006_reembedding_and_status_tracking.description: Re-embedding & status tracking: adds legacy_embedding_128, embedding_status ('ready'/'pending_reembed'), updates hybrid_search

007_reembedding_leases_and_deadletter.description: Re-embedding leases, retries, and dead-letter queue: non-blocking lease claiming, attempt tracking, failure tolerance

008_identity_persistence_and_github_bind.description: Cross-channel identity persistence & server-owned GitHub repository bindings with webhook delivery replay protection

009_delivery_ledger_states.description: Webhook delivery processing lifecycle states: processing, completed, failed
